title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Desk Instrument for Charging a Credit Reissue Fee
content:
A traveller who holds a lapsed travel credit from an air booking may ask for it to be put back into use, and under Air Ticket Fare Brands a fee falls to be charged to that traveller for doing so. The desk charges the fee on the booking the credit stands on, against the credit line whose value is being put back into use. The traveller then sees a separate fee line standing on the booking under its own line reference, met out of the travel credit being put back into use, and the booking's paid balance rises by the amount charged.

**Situation of use and capability.** The instrument charges the traveller the fee for putting a lapsed travel credit from an air booking back into use. One call posts a single fee line to that booking's money ledger, filed against the credit line whose value is being put back into use.

**How it is invoked.** The instrument is `charge_credit_reissue_fee_efe635ea`. The desk unlocks it and then calls it, once, to post the charge.

**What it is given.**

* `air_booking_id`: an identifier, being the reference number of the air booking record the fee is charged on, as returned by the air booking lookup for this traveller.
* `source_event_id`: an identifier, being the reference number of the travel credit line on the same booking whose value is being put back into use, as returned by the air booking event lookup.
* `passenger_sequence`: a fixed format, being which traveller on the booking the fee belongs to, in ticket order, written as a whole number starting at 1; there is no empty value and no rounding, since the position is counted exactly.
* `reissue_fee_usd`: a fixed format, being the amount charged to the traveller, as a positive US dollar amount with two decimal places, given to the cent exactly as the published terms produce it; US dollars only, and there is no empty value.

**What comes back.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the new fee line's reference, a string beginning "arif_", the air booking reference the line was posted to, and the amount charged in US dollars to two decimal places. The call has completed when that sentence comes back, and receiving it means the fee line now stands charged on the booking.
